scenarios.name: Return to the notes list from a text note
scenarios.reason:
Opened the notes app from its initial welcome screen.
Created a new note with the title “Milk” and the body “Buy one carton.”
Closed the editor using the Android Back button after the keyboard was hidden.
The notes list was displayed and contained the new “Milk” note.

steps.remark: wait: PRIMARY: verify no Android permission prompt is present before creating a note
click: Clicking create new text note button
type: Entering Milk into the note title field
analyze: the on-screen keyboard is visible
press_key: PRIMARY: press the Android system Back key once from the visible note editor
analyze: the notes list contains Milk
assert: the notes list is visible and contains Milk

fix.summary: MainActivity backgrounded the app before the editor could handle Back. It now dispatches Back to the editor so the user returns to the notes list.

attempts.summary: MainActivity backgrounded the app before the editor could handle Back. It now dispatches Back to the editor so the user returns to the notes list.
